reviews.title: Terrible to unsubscribe
reviews.text: The process to unsubscribe is ridiculous and complicated for no reason. I started the trail on my phone and when I went to manage subscription it sends you to their website where you are asked to log into so I tried to log into it with the email and password that I used on the app. It said that it was invalid so the log in platforms are different from the app/ website. Once I requested to reset my password I got into the website version which then told me that the subscription was purchased through the App Store so I would have to unsubscribe through the app. The app literally directed me to their website to manage the subscription!!! So went to “contact” information and not surprised there’s no number to reach out only “frequently asked questions”. I then proceeded to find a small link to cancel subscription through apple where it gives you directions to go into your phone subscription to cancel. So literally did not have to go into the app to unsubscribe. This was the most complicated subscription I had to unsubscribe too. Never again

reviews.title: Easy learning
reviews.text:
My daughter was struggling with basic reading skills and was behind her class in 1st grade. She would get very frustrated when we practiced at home, and the school system wasn’t able to devote extra instruction for her.

I signed her up for Hooked on Phonics to get more practice at home over the summer. She was on track with where she was supposed to be by the beginning of 2nd grade, and at the end of 3rd grade she was reading 3 grade levels above! 

She used the app heavily for the first summer and made remarkable progress. The games were simple but educational and entertaining enough that she never complained. We also got the books in the mail, and some of them she absolutely loved. By the end of 3rd grade she was reading voraciously and likes to pick her own books. I have no doubt that Hooked on Phonics helped get her where she is now.

I would recommend this for any parent with a young learning reader!
